name: comment-atomic-write-fsync
title: Comment the best-effort directory fsync in the atomic-write path
description: The atomic-write helper in scripts/sd_ai_command_pack_lib.py swallows OSError around a best-effort fsync of the directory handle with no comment. The swallow is correct -- the file's own data is already flushed and fsynced and the replace has happened, so only durability of the directory entry is at stake -- but nothing says so. Six consumer repositories raised the same Empty except finding against the copied payload during the 2026-08-12 fleet conversion; each was rebutted, and it will recur on every pack refresh. Add the comment in both the scripts/ and templates/scripts/ copies, change no behavior, and record why the two false-positive families found alongside it -- the @overload ... bodies and the annotated STATE_HOME_ENV re-export -- are left alone.
creator: sdelmas
